title: BetterPanabo site configuration
description: Central configuration for the portal. See src/Data/Site/README.md for examples.

site.description: The site's identity: used for page titles, link previews, the sitemap and robots.txt.

url.description: Public address of the site, without a trailing slash. Change this if the portal moves to a custom domain.

name.description: Site name, added after each page title ("Guide Hub | <name>") and shown in link previews.

tagline.description: What the site is, in a few words, e.g. "Panabo City Community Portal". Shown under the name in the logo, on the home page and on the About page.

title.description: Home page title in browser tabs and search results. Keep it under about 70 characters.

description.description: Default description for search results and link previews. Keep it under about 160 characters.

license.description: The license for the site's content, shown in the footer, on the About page and in the Terms of Use.

short.description: Short name for the footer, e.g. "CC0".

contact.description: Where people can report a mistake: an email address ("hello@example.org") or a link, e.g. a Facebook page. Shown on the About page; leave it "" to hide the contact line.

repository.description: The site's source code on GitHub, linked under the mission in the footer. Leave it out to hide the link.

pages.description: Pages of this site, in navbar order. Pages with a "group" go into that group's dropdown and footer column; the rest appear under "Portal" in the footer.

tools.description: Community tools: separate apps that open in a new tab. In a navbar group they're listed under "Community tools", after the group's pages; without a group they come after the pages, and appear under "Tools" in the footer.

resources.description: Outside links, shown under "Resources" in the footer.

popularGuides.description: "Popular" shortcuts under the home page search bar.

disabled.description: Still shown, but greyed out with a "Soon" label and not clickable.

hidden.description: Not shown anywhere. Handy for switching something back on later.

navbar.description: Show in the top navigation bar.

group.description: Puts this item in a navbar dropdown, and a footer column, with every other page and tool of the same group, e.g. "Services" or "Transparency". The dropdown appears where the group's first page is listed. Leave it out for a plain link.

path.description: Route on this site, starting with "/". It must exist in src/Routes/AppRoute.jsx.

footerGroup.description: Puts the page in this footer column instead of its "group" (or the Portal column), without changing the navbar. E.g. Emergency Hotlines is a plain navbar link but sits under "Services" in the footer.

description.description: One short line under the link in its navbar dropdown. Only used when the page has a group.

icon.description: Icon next to the link in its navbar dropdown: a lucide-react icon name in PascalCase, e.g. "BookOpen" (https://lucide.dev/icons). Only used when the page has a group.

name.description: The app's name, e.g. "NaboMap". For your records; not shown on the site right now.

label.description: Link text in the navbar and footer, e.g. "City Map".

title.description: A short heading, e.g. "Explore the city". Not shown on the site right now (it was on the home page's tool cards).

description.description: One sentence about the tool. Not shown on the site right now (it was on the home page's tool cards).

icon.description: A lucide-react icon name in PascalCase, e.g. "MapPinned". Browse them at https://lucide.dev/icons.
